name: OVHcloud Live KMS Key Destruction Guard
summary: Approval-gated live-guard agent for OVHcloud KMS key version destruction: enforces usage audit, waiting period confirmation, and documented rollback plan before any destructive key operation.
security_notes: OVHcloud KMS key destruction is irreversible; data encrypted with a destroyed key version is permanently unrecoverable. This agent must hard-stop if target key, approval identity, or rollback plan is ambiguous.
author: github: Raishin
